Of course! Let me know what time you're free so we can plan accordingly.

Great, I'd love to meet up there. How about 5 PM tomorrow? That should give us enough time for a meal and some exploration of the park.
What time is that for your day?

Thanks for the suggestion! I'm looking forward to spending time with you and your family tomorrow. What do you think about hiking in the park this time? Would it be a good opportunity for us to catch up on our shared interests?
Oh, you know me! I love to go for a run in the morning. Do you?
